name: Montizón (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Montizón (a tree and the letters N, P and D on yellow, inscribed SIERRA MORENA).
history: Municipal flag of Montizón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Montizón arms — tree and the letters N, P and D on yellow, inscribed SIERRA MORENA
